result.title: Data-Efficient Algal Bloom Segmentation in Freshwater Bodies Using a Three-Stage Transfer Learning Pipeline with Attention-Enhanced Decoding
result.summary: Harmful algal blooms threaten water quality and public health, yet automated segmentation of bloom regions in freshwater imagery is limited by scarce pixel-level annotations. We present a transfer-learning pipeline that adapts a Swin Transformer U-Net with SCSE decoder attention from ImageNet-1K to water-body segmentation (RIWA, LaRS) and then to algal blooms, together with a model-assisted annotation protocol that expands the labelled algae corpus from 145 to 655 images. In a single-seed ablation on a 41-image validation split (checkpoint S2-A4 and its variants), corpus expansion is the dominant factor (+11 mIoU points); water-body pretraining helps only on the expanded corpus (+1.1 points over ImageNet initialization); SCSE attention adds 0.3 points; and a learnable positional encoding lowers mIoU by 0.6 points and is omitted. Adding 476 images, 188 of them algae-free, reduces false-positive area on non-water scenes from 22.6% to 4.9%. Against nine baselines on a 256-image test split, a separately trained checkpoint of the same architecture (S2-A13) reaches mIoU 0.919 and the highest algae IoU (0.902); a near-duplicate audit indicates train/test overlap in this split, so these scores are likely optimistic.

AI.brief_summary: 该文面向淡水水体藻华图像分割，采用 Swin Transformer U-Net 加 SCSE 解码器注意力的三阶段迁移学习流程，并配合模型辅助标注把藻类像素标注语料从 145 张扩到 655 张，做了消融与基线对比。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于遥感/环境分割的迁移学习与标注扩充工作，没有视觉推理状态、证据获取、停止决策或 latent 表示的使用与监督，SCSE 解码器注意力与位置编码消融也只是常规分割工程细节，与 LVR 主线缺少可核查的具体联系。
